Environment: we don't pin an image. The replay runs against your own tree, under its own .venv or node_modules/.bin, so a fix recorded on another host isn't treated as valid on yours. Pulled claims arrive as proposed and show as held elsewhere, not reproduced here, and a pulled pin is never installed until you pass --trust-eval. It only counts for you once it replays on your machine.

Staleness: no TTL. A build or test recipe eval is bound to the bytes it ran against, so if the manifest changes, the replay refuses with proof-artifact-drift instead of passing on old evidence. An optional observed digest also warns when the installed package changed under an unchanged pin. And a row stays in the ledger only while its eval can still prove the failure; prune retires the rest.
